## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance
- [ ] Security or migration

## Validation

List commands run and any relevant manual verification.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] No secrets or private data were committed
- [ ] Documentation was updated when needed
- [ ] Any cloud, migration, or release-control work has maintainer approval
